description: The tax cut policies of the Republican challengers in Senate District 49A (Stacy Bettison) and 49B (Wendi Russo) promise a return to the multi-billion dollar budget deficits of the Republican Tim Pawlenty administration, which hurt public education and left many Minnesotans without health insurance. They offer tax cuts but no plan for how to pay for it. It is a time warp back to the Republican Tim Pawlenty years, where taxes were cut and budget deficits ballooned, including a $4.5 billion budget

title: Letter to the Editor: Letter writer criticizes GOP tax plans, backs DFL House candidates Falconer, Kotyza-Witthuhn
